spectral.true_color: High confidence: fields range from medium or dark green to muted tan and gray-brown. Settlement contains small white and gray bright surfaces mixed with dark green vegetation. Dark field margins contrast with comparatively smooth interiors. The compact anomaly near bottom_center has unusually saturated colors.
spectral.false_color: High confidence: northern fields are strongly red, the large central-western field is red to pink with a darker internal band, and gardens form fragmented red patches among cyan-gray built surfaces. The large pale northern parcel and southwestern pale fields are comparatively gray-green, indicating weaker relative near-infrared expression in this rendering.

implications.claim: Bright red fields contain substantial photosynthetically active vegetation; relative differences may reflect canopy amount, structure or vigor.
Differences in red intensity cannot be attributed uniquely to plant health because crop identity, cover fraction, soil background and display scaling also affect appearance.
Pale true-color fields with muted false-color responses likely have less green vegetation and more exposed soil, dry vegetation or residue.
White or cyan compact objects within the settlement are consistent with reflective roofs or other artificial surfaces.
Dark strips may contain dense woody vegetation or shadows; darkness alone does not establish high moisture or standing water.
No substantial open-water body is confidently identifiable, so water turbidity cannot be assessed.
Soil and vegetation moisture differences cannot be reliably inferred from these rendered visible and near-infrared composites alone.

spectral.not_revealed: High confidence: these renderings do not provide calibrated reflectance, quantitative vegetation indices, soil moisture, crop species, yield, irrigation status, water chemistry or temporal change. They also do not establish building use, vegetation species, exact phenological dates or the cause of individual spectral anomalies.

summaries.w50: High confidence: large agricultural fields dominate the west and north, while settlement concentrates eastward and across the lower center. Bright false-color reds indicate substantial green vegetation. Medium confidence: pale fields have sparse cover, dry vegetation or exposed soil. Crop identity, season, moisture and recent management remain unresolved.
summaries.w100: High confidence: this 1.2 km patch contains an agricultural and settlement mosaic, with broad fields westward and northward and finer building, garden and road texture eastward. Strong false-color reds identify substantial green vegetation, contrasting with pale parcels in the northwest and southwest. Medium confidence: these differences reflect vegetation cover or management stages, including possible bare soil or residue. Woody boundaries divide some fields. No substantial open water is confidently identifiable. Individual buildings and narrow boundaries are poorly resolved at 10 m. Crop types, season, moisture status and active agricultural processes remain uncertain.
